functionDescriptions: Component of the small ribosomal subunit (Probable) (Ref.8). The ribosome is a large ribonucleoprotein complex responsible for the synthesis of proteins in the cell (PubMed:23636399). Interacts with the beta subunit of protein kinase CKII and stimulates phosphorylation of DNA topoisomerase II alpha by CKII (PubMed:9299532). {ECO:0000269|PubMed:23636399, ECO:0000269|PubMed:9299532, ECO:0000305|Ref.8}.
